articles.summary: The key to building a profitable portfolio is not to view US casualty as one single market – or make decisions using broad market averages, says Christopher Larson, Global Head of Casualty Underwriting at SiriusPoint. In the day one edition of Intelligent Insurer at the American Property Casualty Insurance Association (APCIA) Annual Meeting, Chris covers […]
articles.title: Good Risk Selection Must Trump Growth in Casualty
